## How it works

- `themes/wenfang.json` — the single source: five hand-tuned colors
plus the Codex syntax id and con

pins them byte-for-byte.
- `scripts/lib/dsh.mjs` — derives ~30 `--dsw-*` tokens per variant
(surfac
